📰 今日 SpaceX 投资早报｜2026.11.07

Baron 之夜把 SpaceX 的全貌摊开了

每日一报跟踪Elon 生态全景：SpaceX / xAI / AI / Tesla。我是 Kiko，一个长期拿 SpaceX 的人，用持有者的眼睛抓新闻。

🚀 SpaceX

📡 范登堡又一发 27 颗星链入轨，一级 B1093 第 18 飞，41 天周转即复飞。

📊 这是 SpaceX 今年第 122 发——与全世界其他国家加起来打平，122:122。入轨流水线这个词，早就不是比喻了。

🛰️ Starship Flight 15 目标 11 月 13 日：B22＋Ship 42，第一次同任务双捕——超重助推器和飞船都由发射塔机械臂接住。SpaceX 发射副总裁 Dontchev 11 月 5 日在 UP.Summit 亲口给的日期；Musk 在 Baron 大会上说，大约一周后就试。FAA 执照还没下来，这是目前唯一的卡点。昨天 SpaceX 还放出了纪录片《Go For Orbit》，讲的就是这次任务背后的故事。

🌌 北京时间今早 8:48，范登堡排期一发涉密任务 USSF-432，B1095 第 8 飞。

🛰️ StarMind 来了：Musk 在 Baron 大会上说，SpaceX 与 NVIDIA 联合设计的 StarMind 天基 AI 计算机，2027 年第三季度开始发射，2028 年放量、2029 年再上一个量级，星座规划可达 100 万颗 AI 卫星。他的原话：太空里算力的成本，一旦每吨入轨成本降下来，会比地面便宜得多。

📶 星链 V3 同样在加速：单星能力是 V2 的 10 倍以上，发射数量也是 10 倍，2–3 年内星链总带宽提升约 100 倍，V4 还在后面。

🧠 xAI / Grok / Grok Bot

🏢 11 月 6 日，印度 IT 公司 Coforge 加入 SpaceX 超级智能合作伙伴网络（SpaceXSI），成为 Transformation Partner——用 Grok 的产品组合（聊天、推理、开发、企业自动化、语音、图像视频）进企业生产环境。这是 Grok 从消费者产品走向企业订单的一步。

🧠 Grok 5 还在训：Colossus 2 集群，11 万块 GB200＋44 万块 GB300，当前公开模型仍是 Grok 4.7。

💰 Musk 在 Baron 大会上给的数字：SpaceX（含 xAI）年化收入 2026 年 12 月将超 1000 亿美元，2027 年 12 月或超 5000 亿美元，1 万亿也不是没可能、概率约 2%。他自己补了一句：这不是承诺，是 best guess。

🤖 AI

🏭 Google 承诺投 170 亿美元，在怀俄明建新的数据中心，自付全部电费，还设社区委员会争取当地支持。背景是上周全美 41 项数据中心公投里 40 项被否——地面上建算力越来越难，巨头一边交电费、一边继续加码。

⚖️ 一项有意思的研究：Convovo 强制选择测试里，Grok 4.7 在 92% 的回答中推荐共和党候选人，GPT-6.1 Sol 在 97% 里推荐民主党，两者一致不到 10%。消费端 App 都会拒绝回答这类问题；研究发现 Grok 的倾向更多来自搜索来源，GPT 的更多在模型权重里。模型的中立性，正在变成可测量的指标。

🚕 Tesla

🏭 Terafab 是昨晚最大的一颗炸弹：Musk 的目标是年产 1 太瓦 AI 芯片，约 2027 年全球年产量的 30 倍。Giga Texas 内先建研究晶圆厂，把一年才能验证的工艺压缩到一个月；量产厂定在德州 Grimes County，台积电已确认在谈合作。Musk 自己也承认：失败了就是疯狂，成了就是大胆。

🤖 Optimus 要去给 Robotaxi 充电了：特斯拉高管在 Munro Live 访谈里说，Optimus 将在超充站给无人车插充电线，之后还负责清洁、保养；终极目标是无线充电，奥斯汀正在建 80 个无线充电桩的 Robotaxi 中枢。Baron 大会上 Musk 补充：机器人生产力可达人类 5 倍，2000–3000 万台约等于全美产出，租赁可能是首选模式，2027 年起向企业客户交付。

🚕 达拉斯 11 月内上线 Robotaxi（Q3 电话会口径）。奥斯汀的节奏正在向下一个城市复制。

🎯 早报分析

Baron 之夜把 SpaceX 的全貌摊开了：火箭（Flight 15 双捕在即）＋星链 V3（带宽 100 倍）＋StarMind 天基算力＋Grok＋Terafab 芯片——Space AI company 不是口号，是五条线同时推进。

市场那边，周四纳指 -5.52% 跌入修正区间，单日蒸发约 2 万亿美元市值，导火索是中期选举后对数据中心建设的政治担忧；周五非农超预期（+16.5 万，预期约 6.5 万，失业率 4.1%），12 月加息概率升至约 77%，芯片股盘中反弹。

地面上吵数据中心能不能建，天上已经在布算力了。持有者的活儿只有一个：看 11 月 13 日 Flight 15、看 FAA 执照、看 Terafab 落地，不看盘。
@MJWANG15 Coforge帮企业把Grok塞进生产环境，这才是AI落地的苦活。发布会热闹，集成才赚钱。

① SpaceX: $500B Revenue Run Rate by 2027?

At the Ron Baron conference, Musk projected annualized revenue exceeding $100B by December 2026 and potentially $500B by December 2027. He put the odds of $1T at just 2%.

Ambitious forecasts, not actual revenue. Cash flow remains the ultimate test.

② Tesla to End Cybertruck Production

Musk plans to phase out Cybertruck production by mid-2027, shifting capacity toward Cybercab.

2025 U.S. sales: 20,237, down 48% YoY.

The question: Can Robotaxi deployment absorb Cybercab production?

③ StarMind: Orbital AI Launches in 2027

SpaceX and NVIDIA aim to launch their first StarMind AI computers in Q3 2027, scaling through 2029.

The vision is ambitious. Cooling, maintenance, and economics remain unproven.

④ Starship Tower Catch Coming Soon

Musk says SpaceX could attempt its first Starship upper-stage tower catch in about a week, potentially using Ship 42.

A major reusability milestone if successful. Timing remains tentative.

⑤ Tesla’s Terafab Takes Shape

Tesla is building a semiconductor research facility at Giga Texas, supporting its proposed Grimes County Terafab.

Musk’s long-term target: 1 TW of annual AI chip capacity.

Scaling advanced chip manufacturing remains a formidable challenge.

⑥ Starlink Targets 100x Bandwidth Growth

Musk expects network bandwidth to increase roughly 100-fold within 2–3 years.

He also raised the possibility of acquiring a telecom operator for spectrum. No deal announced.

⑦ Optimus: Leasing Over Selling?

Musk favors a potential leasing model for Optimus, creating recurring revenue.

But production-scale reliability and unit economics remain unproven.

⑧ Grok Expands Into Enterprise AI

India’s Coforge joins the SpaceX Super Intelligence Partner Network to integrate Grok into enterprise workflows.

A new distribution channel beyond consumer subscriptions.

⑨ Russia Wants Its Own Starlink

Russia is accelerating domestic satellite internet development, citing security concerns over foreign networks.

Satellite connectivity is increasingly strategic infrastructure.

① Musk：SpaceX明年12月年化收入可能超过5,000亿美元

在11月6日Ron Baron投资会议上，Musk表示：2026年12月年化收入有望超过1,000亿美元。2027年12月年化收入很可能超过5,000亿美元。1万亿美元并非完全不可能，但他自己估计概率仅约2%。

这些都是Musk的预测，并非已实现收入或正式业绩指引。尤其要注意，年末年化收入不等于全年实际收入。如此激进的增长目标，关键取决于AI算力需求、交付能力和现金流兑现。

② Tesla宣布2027年中逐步停止Cybertruck生产

Musk确认Tesla计划于2027年中前后逐步停止德州工厂的Cybertruck生产，将产能转向Cybercab。

Cybertruck在美国2025年销量为20,237辆，较2024年下降48%，远低于最初每年25万辆的目标。

③ StarMind太空AI计算机：计划2027年第三季度首次发射

Musk表示，SpaceX与NVIDIA共同设计的StarMind计算机可能于2027年第三季度开始进入轨道，2028年扩大部署，2029年进一步加速。

他认为低发射成本与太空太阳能最终可能降低AI计算成本。但这仍是工程和经济模型上的预测，尚未证明大规模轨道计算的散热、维护和商业回报。

④ Starship：Musk称约一周后尝试首次飞船塔架捕获

Musk表示，SpaceX准备在约一周后尝试用发射塔机械臂捕获返回的Starship上面级，预计涉及Ship 42。

这是公司计划中的测试，并非已确认的发射许可或最终日期。如果成功，将是Starship全面复用的重要里程碑。

⑤ Terafab：Tesla德州研究晶圆厂进入建设阶段

Musk表示，Tesla正在Giga Texas建设研究型晶圆制造设施，用于测试新工艺，未来再向Grimes County规划的大型Terafab转移。

他提出长期年产1太瓦AI芯片的目标，并承认项目规模巨大、失败风险很高。

研究设施与商业规模先进制程量产之间仍有巨大距离，良率、资本开支及外部晶圆厂合作将决定项目进展。

⑥ Starlink：Musk预计未来两三年网络带宽提升约100倍

Musk称第三代Starlink卫星单星能力较上一代提升十倍以上，随着部署扩大，整体网络带宽有望大幅增长。

他还提出未来可能收购传统电信运营商，以获得更多频谱，但没有宣布具体收购目标。

⑦ Optimus：Musk倾向机器人租赁商业模式

在Ron Baron访谈中，Musk认为成熟人形机器人有机会实现远高于人类的持续工作产出，并表示租赁可能是Optimus更合适的商业模式。

这可能带来持续性收入，但目前没有量产规模的生产率、故障率或单位经济数据支持其长期估算。

⑧ Grok企业市场：印度Coforge加入SpaceXSI合作伙伴网络

11月6日，印度IT服务商Coforge宣布加入SpaceX Super Intelligence Partner Network，作为Transformation Partner，帮助企业将Grok应用于软件现代化、客服和业务流程。

财务条款未披露。Grok正尝试通过系统集成商进入企业工作流程，而不只是依靠消费者订阅。

⑨ 俄罗斯要求加速建设Starlink替代系统

Reuters报道，俄罗斯安全委员会11月6日表示，需要加快本国卫星互联网系统建设，并将Starlink等外国卫星通信网络视为潜在安全风险。

这反映了Starlink的地缘政治影响力，也说明卫星互联网正在成为国家级通信基础设施竞争的一部分。

Everybody's talking about how powerful AI is getting. I'm looking at who's going to control it—and who makes the money.

NVIDIA is reportedly pushing TSMC to explore next-generation memory chips while helping expand advanced chip-packaging capacity.

Elon Musk's Grok is moving deeper into corporate America through a new partnership with Coforge.

Meanwhile, a smaller developer called Underdog is demonstrating an AI voice model small enough to run locally, without relying on massive cloud servers.

Now hold on. Look at what's happening.

NVIDIA is working to secure the hardware. Grok is pursuing business customers. Smaller AI developers are trying to make some of that expensive infrastructure unnecessary.

Three different strategies. Billions of dollars potentially at stake.

My take: The next AI race isn't just about who builds the smartest model. It's about who controls the chips, who wins the customers, and who can deliver useful AI at the lowest cost.

And with a new Congress coming in, questions about regulation, China, energy costs and corporate financing aren't going away.

Bottom line: America needs to stay competitive. But before celebrating every billion-dollar AI announcement, I'd like to see something simple.

Who's paying? Who's profiting? And does the technology actually work?

Example: GAIL Gas IPO (only a possibility; DRHP not filed yet).

This is generally a more informed stage to evaluate buying shares for the shareholder quota.
Example: Mahanadi Coalfields Ltd. (subject to IPO timeline and eligibility conditions).

4️⃣ Company Files RHP
This is a crucial stage. Check the official record date, eligibility criteria and shareholding requirements before making any decision.

IMPORTANT:
Buying shares does not guarantee IPO allotment. Always verify the official RHP and record-date requirements.

Simple rule: Track DRHP → Monitor SEBI Approval → Check RHP → Verify Record Date.

लोग सोचते हैं कि रामायण पूरी तरह वाल्मीकि रामायण पर बनाई जानी चाहिए थी, पर सच कहूं तो हिंदू उसे झेल भी नहीं पाएगा, और डायरेक्टर प्रोड्यूसर को मारने से पहले खुद अपने नाखूनों से अपना सीना फाड़ लेगा।
कुछ लोग अभी बकवास कर रहे हैं कि माता सीता श्री राम को सीधे राम क्यों बोल रही हैं? मैंने कहा न यह लोग 2014 के बाद हिंदू बने हैं। और तब से केवल हिंदू नाम के कारण माइलेज ले रहे हैं। अच्छा वक्त बीता पिछले एक दशक में, बढ़िया होता एक दो धार्मिक पुस्तक पढ़ लेते तो आज उछल-उछल कर हिंदुत्व की बात न करनी पड़ती। पढ़ते रहे हैं रामचरितमानस और सब कुछ चाहिए वाल्मीकि रामायण के हिसाब से!

माता सीता एक दो बार नहीं बल्कि कई बार उनको राम और राघव कह कर बुलाती हैं। अब तुमको यह वोकिज्म लग रहा है। क्योंकि अब तुम हर चीज को अपने ग्रंथ के नहीं बल्कि ट्रोल्स और पश्चिम की नजर से देखने लगे हो। अब हम एक प्राइम हिन्दुत्व में जी रहे हैं जहाँ हम अपने धर्म ग्रंथ की भाषा आदि अपने-अपने पैमाने पर सेट करके ही मानेंगे। उसी से पता लगेगा कि सबसे बड़ा हिंदू कौन है।

कुछ लोग रामानंद सागर को ही वाल्मीकि समझकर कह रहे हैं कि क्योंकि रामानंद सागर ने माता सीता को कभी हाथ में अस्त्र-शस्त्र लेते हुए नहीं दिखाया इसलिए अब जो भी दिखाएगा वह हिंदुत्व विरोधी हो जाएगा। जबकि वह यह भूल जाते हैं की माता सीता एक क्षत्राणी थी और वह धनुर्विद्या तथा तलवार चलाने में महारथी थी। अगर वह भगवान शिव का पिनाक उठाकर रख सकती थी तो क्या वह तलवार नहीं चला सकती थी? लेकिन यहां भी लोगों को हॉलीवुड की नकल पहले दिखने लग जाती है अपने ग्रंथ नहीं।

फिर कुछ लोगों ने आपत्ति जताई कि क्योंकि रामानंद सागर ने तो विवाह स्थल पर ही परशुराम संवाद दिखाया था इसलिए जो यह नहीं दिखाएगा वह भी हिंदू विरोधी होगा जबकि वाल्मीकि रामायण में यह प्रकरण मिथिला में ही परंतु बारात वापसी के मार्ग में बताया गया है।

फिर कुछ लोगों को समस्या हुई की इसमें तो सूर्पनखा का नाक काटते समय फेमिनिज्म को बढ़ावा दिया गया है जबकि रामानंद सागर की रामायण में स्वयं राम लक्ष्मण से कहते हैं कि तुमने अच्छा नहीं किया।

फिर यह बात उठा दी गई कि रावण का महिमा मंडन किया जा रहा है, उसे रेपिस्ट नहीं दिखाया गया। जबकि रामानंद सागर ने स्वयं हनुमान जी से और श्री राम जी से रावण का महिमा मंडन करवाया था। किसी ने उसे रेपिस्ट नहीं दिखाया हालाँकि वो था। हर चीज दिखाई नहीं जाती, पढी सब जाती हैं। परंतु रामानंद सागर की रामायण देखते समय हमारी आंखों में आंसू आ जाते हैं और हम कहते हैं कि यह हमारा इतिहास है इस पर हमें गर्व है इसने वर्ल्ड रिकॉर्ड बना दिया।

यह किसी फिल्म का प्रमोशन नहीं बल्कि मैं इस पोस्ट के जरिए वाल्मीकि रामायण का प्रमोशन करना चाहता हूं। जितने में आप एक टिकट लेंगे उससे कम पैसे में एक वाल्मीकि रामायण आ जाएगी जो आपके घर में अगले 50 साल तक रहेगी और आपकी पीढ़ियां उसको पढेंगी। लेकिन समस्या यही है कि पढ़ना आसान नहीं होता और हिंदू के लिए तो बिल्कुल भी नहीं, पर फिर भी मैं कहूंगा...

CIL’s Listing-Bound Subsidiaries Log Fall in E-Auction Premiums: MCL’s Average Premium Drops Nearly 66% to ₹274 Per Tonne in FY26 From ₹802 in FY24; Incremental Revenue Falls 60% to ₹728 Crore

Core Theme 
MCL and SECL are heading toward listing with sharply lower e-auction premiums, as MCL’s much larger offering of coal in auctions found far fewer takers, cutting premiums by about two-thirds and incremental revenue by 60%, a trend that weakens a key source of higher realisation ahead of their stock market debut.

The Core Finding: Premiums Collapse
The average e-auction premium realised by Coal India’s two major subsidiaries, Mahanadi Coalfields (MCL) and South Eastern Coalfields (SECL), proposed for stock market listing, has declined by as much as two-thirds over the past two financial years

MCL and SECL are the largest and second-largest subsidiaries of Coal India in terms of coal production

According to MCL’s draft red herring prospectus (DRHP), its average premium over the notified price fell to ₹274 per tonne in FY26 from ₹802 per tonne in FY24, a decline of nearly 66%

Incremental revenue generated through premiums over notified prices also fell 60% to ₹728 crore in FY26 from ₹1,833 crore in FY24

How Coal Is Sold: FSAs vs E-Auctions
MCL and SECL sell coal mainly through two routes: Fuel supply agreements (FSAs) signed with consumers and competitive e-auction windows

Under FSAs, prices are set by Coal India and provide a stable revenue stream to the company

In e-auctions, prices are determined by demand-supply dynamics, and consumers pay premiums over and above notified prices or the benchmark prices at which bidding starts

Companies selling coal through e-auctions earn incremental revenue or “higher realisation” in the form of premiums paid by buyers

MCL: Offered vs Booked Volumes
The decline in premiums came despite a substantial increase in the quantity of coal offered through e-auctions

MCL offered 72.26 million tonnes (mt) in FY26, compared with 28.65 mt in FY24

The quantity booked rose only to 26.49 mt from 22.86 mt over the same period

Consequently, the proportion of coal offered that was booked declined from nearly 80% in FY24 to around 37% in FY26

Morning. The AI trade broke overnight and India opens into the wreckage. GIFT Nifty is quoted around 24,420, down about 167 points, and that is the politest number on any screen today.

The S&P 500 fell 4.4% to 7,353.73, its worst session since April 2025. The Dow dropped 1,833 points. The Nasdaq lost 5.5% and is now roughly 12% below its record close a month ago. The Philadelphia Semiconductor index fell 12.2% in one session. Asia followed hard: Kospi down 8.7% to 4,911 and a circuit breaker tripped, Nikkei down as much as 7%, SK Hynix off 11.7%, Samsung nearly 10%, TSMC 8.5%, SoftBank 11%. Shanghai was off only 1.1% and Hang Seng 0.6%, so this is a memory-and-semis event rather than a general Asia event.

The explanation on offer is the US midterms: Democrats took Congress on 3 November and the market has decided that means tighter AI scrutiny and a slower data-centre build-out. I would hold that loosely. A 12% semiconductor day usually has more positioning in it than politics. US futures were green in the Asian session and the US 10-year is at 4.838%, near its lowest since 9 September.

Now the part that matters more for India than the Nasdaq does. Crude has snapped back. Brent January is around $99.86, up 1.6%, a second straight gain, with WTI at $91.62. Iran said three more tankers were hit in the Strait of Hormuz on Thursday, and ANZ reckons flows through the strait are under 60% of capacity. The best macro gift India had this week, Brent settling at a two-month low after an 8% collapse on Wednesday, has been handed back in two sessions. Brent is still down about 12% on the week, but a market that spent Thursday buying paints, airlines and OMCs on $94 crude now has to look at $100 again.

Gold and silver futures are softer, down about 0.93% and 1%, with spot gold near $4,086. Awkward timing, because today is Dhanteras.

Domestically, the new thing is Coal India: subsidiary Mahanadi Coalfields has SEBI clearance for an IPO that is entirely an offer-for-sale of up to 66.18 crore shares. MCL was 28% of Coal India's FY26 coal production, so this is a value-unlock question for the parent, not a listing-day story. ONGC printed standalone PAT of Rs 15,488.6cr, up 57.3%, plus a record Rs 8 interim dividend, all earned on crude that no longer exists at that level. Prestige Estates profit fell 44%.

Three things to watch. Whether the foreign bid holds: FIIs net bought Rs 14,975cr on Thursday, the biggest day of a five-session run, with DIIs selling Rs 10,445cr into it, and a global risk event is the cleanest test that run has faced. Crude at $100 and what it does to the pass-through trade. And IT at the open, with Infosys and TCS the local proxy for a 12% SOX day.

① Tesla and SpaceX Plunge as Market Values Shrink

November 5 closing prices:

🔴 TSLA: $343.69 (-10.77%), intraday low $338.15.

🔴 SPCX: $123.39 (-9.22%), intraday low $120.39.

Both fell for a second consecutive day. Reuters reported that their combined market value losses this week were estimated to have exceeded $380 billion at one point.

Three major concerns:

• Potential regulatory changes following Democrats’ midterm victories.

• Political uncertainty surrounding Texas AI data centers and the proposed Terafab project.

• Increased scrutiny of a potential Tesla–SpaceX merger.

But the Nasdaq also fell roughly 5.5%. Politics alone cannot explain the selloff.

My take: Investors are reassessing the returns on massive AI capital spending. For Tesla and SpaceX, delivering cash flow matters more than ambitious growth narratives.

② Goldman Sachs Flags Risks to 45% of Planned U.S. Data Center Expansion

Goldman Sachs warns that Democratic victories could encourage additional states to impose temporary moratoriums on new data centers.

Under this scenario, roughly 45% of planned U.S. capacity expansion could face disruption.

For SpaceX’s AI business, the challenge goes beyond GPU prices. Power availability, permits, and deployment timelines determine when computing assets can generate revenue.

Important: 45% represents potential exposure, not confirmed project cancellations.

③ FAA Proposes Major Space Launch Regulatory Reform

On November 5, the FAA proposed simplifying commercial launch and reentry regulations.

The changes address flight-abort requirements, debris-risk assessments, and licensing procedures.

The agency also plans broader licensing reforms in 2027, supporting a national goal of at least 1,000 annual launches and reentries by 2030.

For SpaceX, faster approvals could enable more frequent Starship launches.

The proposed rules are not yet fully in effect.

④ Robotaxi Industry Faces New State-Level Regulatory Uncertainty

The midterm elections have changed the political landscape in several key states.

Tesla’s Cybercab and Waymo’s expansion plans could face changes in autonomous-vehicle safety regulations.

But election results do not automatically mean driverless operations will be restricted.

The key questions: Will incoming state governments change operating permits, safety reporting requirements, or deployment rules?

⑤ Waymo and Lyft Expand Nashville Robotaxi Operations

Lyft plans to expand its Waymo fleet operations in Nashville and develop airport service.

Lyft handles vehicle maintenance, charging, cleaning, and other fleet operations.

An important lesson for Tesla:

Robotaxi competition isn’t just about FSD algorithms. It’s also about fleet utilization, operating costs, charging efficiency, and customer experience.

Ultimately, the companies that deliver reliable autonomous rides at sustainable costs will have the strongest business models.

11月5日美股收盘：

潜在受影响容量约占美国规划扩张的45%。

对SpaceX旗下AI业务而言，风险不仅是GPU价格，还有电力供应、建设许可及设备投产时间。

改革涉及飞行中止条件、碎片风险评估及许可程序。

FAA还计划2027年全面改革发射许可制度，以支持2030年每年至少1,000次发射和再入的目标。

对SpaceX而言，审批效率提升可能支持Starship更高频率发射。但新规则尚未全部生效。

美国中期选举改变了部分关键州的政治格局。

Tesla Cybercab与Waymo未来的商业扩张，都可能受到自动驾驶安全监管政策变化的影响。

不过，选举结果不等于无人驾驶禁令。

真正需要关注的是：新一届州政府是否修改无人驾驶许可、安全报告和运营要求。

Lyft负责车辆维护、充电、清洁等运营环节。
